meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你为聊天频道创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体：确认你的身份，将私信群组连接到新智能体，并通过正常投递路径发送一条欢迎私信。整个过程可重复运行，不会产生副作用。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置且服务正在运行时，你要求 Claude 设置第一个智能体，它会开始引导你完成创建。

say.text: 帮我为 Discord 创建第一个智能体。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的用户 ID 和显示名称等信息。

say.text: 设置第一个 Telegram 智能体，并发送欢迎消息。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成配对码流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: resolve your identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. The process is idempotent and safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: When channel credentials are configured and the service is running, you ask Claude to set up the first agent, and it will start guiding you through the creation.

say_en.text: Help me create the first agent for Discord.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your user ID and display name.

say_en.text: Set up the first Telegram agent and send a welcome message.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the pairing code process.
